def generate_inputs(device):
    # Shape [16, 256, 256] per input specification
    x = torch.zeros(16, 256, 256, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    
    # Set row r to have all values = r + 1.0
    # Expected min over dim2: output[b, r] = r + 1.0
    # Mutant: only computes row 0 (value=1.0), rows 1-255 are garbage
    for row in range(256):
        x[:, row, :] = float(row + 1)
    
    return [x]
